Added: Groups can hold other groups, to any depth (an epic, its milestones, then sessions)
Studio chats and terminal sessions are grouped the same way, from the Sessions page or Studio's list (new By group view)
Labels with a colour, any number per session or studio chat, shown as chips, with a label filter and a Labels manager
A group can follow a ticket: sessions whose branch, title or first message names it join automatically, unless you filed or took them out

whats_new.title: Groups can hold groups, and studios can join them
whats_new.text: Group your sessions as an epic, then its milestones, then sessions, and put Studio chats in the same groups. Add colour labels to cut across them, and let a group follow a ticket so its sessions join on their own.
